description: Utility functions for cryptographic operations, encoding conversions, and environment detection in a web application.

methods.name: getGlobalScope
methods.description: Returns window or global object depending on environment.

methods.name: ieOrEdge
methods.description: Detects if the environment is Internet Explorer or Edge.

methods.name: isWebCryptoAvailable
methods.description: Checks if WebCrypto API is available.

methods.name: getSubtleCrypto
methods.description: Returns the SubtleCrypto instance.

methods.name: generateUUID
methods.description: Generates a UUID string synchronously.

methods.name: stringToArrayBuffer
methods.description: Converts a string to an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: arrayBufferToString
methods.description: Converts an ArrayBuffer to a string.

methods.name: arrayBufferToHexString
methods.description: Converts an ArrayBuffer to a hex string.

methods.name: hexStringToArrayBuffer
methods.description: Converts a hex string to an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: base64ToArrayBuffer
methods.description: Converts a base64 string to an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: arrayBufferToBase64
methods.description: Converts an ArrayBuffer to a base64 string.

methods.name: hexToBase64
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a base64 string.

methods.name: base64ToHex
methods.description: Converts a base64 string to a hex string.

methods.name: base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string to base64.

methods.name: base64URLEncode
methods.description: Encodes a string to URL-safe base64.

methods.name: base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string to plain text.

methods.name: base32Encode
methods.description: Encodes an ArrayBuffer to base32.

methods.name: base32Decode
methods.description: Decodes a base32 string to an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: truncateOTP
methods.description: Truncates HMAC-SHA1 value for OTP.

methods.name: padStart
methods.description: Pads a counter with leading zeros to produce an 8-byte array.
